culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Being topless or shirtless in public is illegal (this does not apply at tourist accommodation). Cover shoulders and knees. Sunday is sacred under the Constitution: no sport is played and contracts signed on a Sunday are void.
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Tonga Tourism (Tonga Visitors Bureau); Constitution of Tonga (Sunday clause).
culture-and-protocol.note: National rules, observed across every island group including ʻEua. Read via search-index snapshots because tongaholiday.com timed out from here; recheck the live page.
